nobs2026_001.name: Conwy Golf Club
nobs2026_001.description: Championship links course on the North Wales coastline. Stunning views of Conwy Mountain, Conwy Estuary and the Great Orme. Hosted the 2021 Curtis Cup. Includes full English breakfast.

nobs2026_002.name: Manchester Golf Club
nobs2026_002.description: Harry Colt masterpiece spanning 240 acres. Lancashire's best inland golf course with moorland, heathland and parkland features. Challenging final holes. Includes full English breakfast.

nobs2026_003.name: Dunham Forest Golf Club
nobs2026_003.description: Championship parkland course set in beautiful Cheshire countryside. Tree-lined fairways and challenging water features. 1pm tee time with soup and sandwiches beforehand.

nobs2026_004.name: Caldy Golf Club
nobs2026_004.description: Premium links course on the Wirral Peninsula with spectacular views over the Dee Estuary and Welsh mountains. Hosted numerous professional tournaments. Includes full English breakfast.

nobs2026_005.name: Vale Royal Golf Club
nobs2026_005.description: Picturesque parkland course in the Cheshire countryside. Well-maintained greens and challenging layout suitable for all abilities. Includes full English breakfast.

nobs2026_006.name: Annual Away Trip - Porthmadog
nobs2026_006.description: Day 1 of annual away trip. Beautiful links course with panoramic views of Snowdonia and Cardigan Bay. 12pm tee time allows travel time. Meal before play TBD. Accommodation: Premier Inn Porthmadog (book your own room). Dinner at restaurant TBD.

nobs2026_007.name: Annual Away Trip - Royal St David's
nobs2026_007.description: Day 2 of annual away trip. Championship links ranked among the world's 100 greatest. Dramatic setting beneath Harlech Castle with views of Snowdonia. 20-minute drive from Porthmadog. Early tee time allows reasonable journey home. Includes full English breakfast.

nobs2026_008.name: Prestatyn Golf Club
nobs2026_008.description: Challenging links course on the North Wales coast. Excellent condition and warm welcome. Good test of golf in autumn conditions. Includes full English breakfast.

nobs2026_009.name: Christmas Team Game & Lunch
nobs2026_009.description: Annual Christmas celebration! Team format competition followed by festive lunch in the clubhouse. Includes breakfast roll before play and Christmas dinner afterwards. Prizes and seasonal cheer guaranteed!
